newsitem.title: USA: Cyclone Gretelle east of Madagascar, lands in 36 hr.
newsitem.headline: Cyclone Gretelle east of Madagascar, lands in 36 hr.

text.p: Tropical Cyclone Gretelle, with 95 mph winds, is east of Madagascar in the southwestern Indian Ocean near 20S/53E, private forecaster Weather Services Corp said.
Landfall is expected in 36 hours along the east central coast of Madagascar, they said.
Gretelle is moving south southwest at eight mph and is expected to turn more to the west southwest again. Top winds may peak at 105 mph in about 24 hours before slightly weakening occurs.
Significant wind damage, flooding, and mudslides will likely occur as Gretelle approaches the shore and then makes landfall.
